'''Dractu''' was a peaceful, undeveloped [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], within the borders of [[Lannik Space/Legends|Lannik Space]], but far from any [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. It was the homeworld of the [[Dractuvian]] people. According to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the planet had the worst food in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
===Geography and wild life===
Dractu was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of terrestrial type with natural conditions suitable for the comfortable existence of most [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-dependent [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, such as [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisks]]. From [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], vast azure [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and elongated masses of murky green land, dotted with inland bodies of water of various sizes isolated from the global hydrosphere, were clearly visible on Dractu.<ref name="CWA" />

[[File:DexOnDractu.jpg|left|thumb|280px|Dexter Jettster walks across the surface of Dractu]]
The surface of Dractu consisted of a succession of hills, fields, [[Forest/Legends|forests]], and rocky [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], where the most characteristic forms of the planet's wildlife inhabited. Nearly everywhere, from the lowlands to the highlands, withered-looking [[Grass/Legends|grass]] spread across the terrain, sometimes barely distinguishable from bare soil. In some places, low leafy shrubs and elongated [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-like [[Plant/Legends|plants]] grew, which, together with scattered boulders, formed forested areas. In the undergrowth, groups of small, timid, [[Unidentified Dractuvian snout-nosed creature|snout-nosed creatures]] and calmer one-eyed [[Unidentified Dractuvian turtle-like creature|turtle-like animals]] moved about. Occasionally, one could unexpectedly fall into deep pools of a yellowish substance between the trees. However, the contents of these pits did not seriously affect health; their danger lay in their deceptive, viscous, and quagmire-like nature.<ref name="CWA" />

[[File:DexDractuNearCave.jpg|right|thumb|280px|Dexter Jettster and his guide found a cave]]
Near the forests, where open spaces remained, low-growing fields spread out, formed by a single species resembling living fibers. Across these fields roamed and fed strong [[Unidentified Dractuvian grazing creature|quadrupedal animals]] capable of running quickly. The same species of meadow plant-like organisms – or a closely related one, only much taller – grew in the shade of trees or clung to rocks. In some places, where forest growth was disrupted and bare trunks remained standing, enormous [[Unidentified Dractuvian arachnid|carnivorous arthropods]] with bright red exoskeletons appeared. These predators moved on elongated, stilt-like legs that could easily be mistaken for tree trunks, a feature the creatures used to their advantage while waiting for prey.<ref name="CWA" />

[[File:DractuvianWithSlug.jpg|left|thumb|280px|A Dractuvian holds a cave slug in its hand]]
Above the fields and forests, passages into the stone mountains could be found. Deep within the [[Cave/Legends|caves]], where light barely penetrated, porous walls were observed, serving as habitats for some slow-moving animals. Hiding within these burrows or crawling across the rocky floor nearby were [[Dractuvian cave slug|small, slimy creatures]] with a glowing spherical appendage that shimmered in the darkness. Less pleasant cave dwellers were [[Dractuvian caveworm|grasping leeches]], which wandered into burrows near the slugs.<ref name="CWA" />

===Sentient inhabitants===
[[File:DractuvianVillagy.jpg|right|thumb|280px|Dexter Jettster in a village of Dractuvians]]
Dractu was the homeworld of lanky, [[Dractuvian|bipedal humanoid species]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], their small civilization had already developed handicrafts and learned basic construction, but the overall level of their society had still not advanced beyond an agrarian stage. The limbs and necks of all adult natives were adorned with rings of varying sizes in silver or gold [[Color/Legends|colors]]. Most members of the species, with rare exceptions, went almost naked, wrapping only their waists with available materials.<ref name="CWA" />

==History==
The planet Dractu<ref name="CWA" /> was located in the part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] known as [[Lannik Space/Legends|Lannik Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> away from major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The planet was once visited by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], where he concluded that, despite the planet's «disgusting» cuisine, cooked cave slugs had the most tolerable taste of all.<ref name="CWA" />

[[File:DexInTrouble.jpg|left|thumb|280px|The misadventures of Dexter Jettster on Dractu]]
During the last decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], a Besalisk chef and owner of his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|own diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], decided to visit the planet Dractu in search of a local [[Dractuvian cave slug|cave slug]], which he believed to be a delicacy. The Besalisk first traveled to a [[Dractuvian village|village]] of the planet's [[Dractuvian|native inhabitants]], who were expected to know the exact habitat of the sought-after slug. In the settlement, after Dexter inquired about the creature, an elder member of the tribe assigned him a [[Unidentified Dractuvian warrior|tracker]] capable of guiding the offworld visitor to his destination.<ref name="CWA" />

During their journey, they encountered a [[Unidentified Dractuvian arachnid|fierce arthropod]] and, by hiding well, avoided the creature's jaws. However, Dexter accidentally stepped into a pit filled with a viscous liquid and, once he realized it, was unable to free himself. The experienced guide then tore a long vine from a tree, handed one end to the Besalisk, tied the other end to a [[Unidentified Dractuvian grazing creature|swift grazing beast]], and struck it on the thigh so that it would pull the sinking traveler free with its strength. At last, the two travelers reached a [[Cave/Legends|cave]], where Dexter collected several slugs he needed for cooking. The satisfied chef and his guide returned to the village, after which the Besalisk departed the planet aboard his [[Dexter Jettster's ship|own ship]].<ref name="CWA" />

[[File:DexLeavesDractu.jpg|right|thumb|280px|Dexter Jettster leaves Dractu]]
Pleased with his success, Dexter returned to Coruscant and promptly turned the slimy creature into an exquisite dish. He served this culinary creation – the goal of his risky adventure – to his friend [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Expecting praise, Dexter was nevertheless taken aback when Obi-Wan described the dish as disgusting, along with all food from the planet Dractu.<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dractu appeared as the setting for the entire story of ''[[Appetite for Adventure]]'', an eighteen-page [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] published in 2007 in ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 9]]''.<ref name="CWA" /> In [[2009]], the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online appendix]] to the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the [[Dractu system/Legends|Dractu star system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square Q-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
